Job Title: AI/ML Platform Engineer 
 
Job Category: Engineering 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10% 
 
Type of Travel: Local 
 
 
* * * 
 
 What You’ll Get to Do:    
 Join CACI as an experienced AI/ML Platform Engineer with our Lisle DevOps team!  In this role you will provide expert support for on-premises LLM-enabled technologies and agentic workflows, ensuring seamless integration and operation within our development and test environments. This role requires a deep understanding of AI infrastructure concepts, DevOps practices, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
   
 More About this Role:   
 Architect a greenfield implementation of LLM-enabled technologies to support agentic workflows
 Deploy, operate, and monitor open-weight LLMs hosted on local Kubernetes clusters
 Design, build, and maintain RAG pipelines to enable use of document investigation, chunking, embedding, retrieval, and reranking with existing models and services
 Develop and maintain Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and their interconnections to existing servicesCoach teams on best practice MCP designs and usage
 Support software automated testing environments
 Collaborate with development to implement CI/CD pipelines
 Instrument tracing and evaluation tools to measure, compare, and iteratively improve existing product cycles
 Provide requirements for network infrastructure to improve model serving performance and accessibility
 Support software development environments and change management systems
   
 You’ll Bring These Qualifications:  
 In-depth Information Technology understanding
 Excellent communication skills, both oral and written
 Software development familiarity with Python, SQL, and Java
 Experience writing data pipelines with Airflow, Spark, Apache Iceberg, or DBT
 Experience managing AI/ML infrastructure through Kubernetes, Kserve, vLLM, LangFuse, Elasticsearch, and Terraform
 Supported Gitlab CI/CD pipelines
 Understanding of RAG, MCP servers, QLoRA, and artifact repositories such as Nexus
 Conceptual understanding of data warehousing and data pipelines from open and proprietary sources
 Ability to work under limited supervision and adapt to change
 Strong organizational and teamwork skills
 Must have good work ethics and show diligence in work performed.
 Must take initiative and ownership of requirements and tasks
 Knowledge of IT system processes involving requirements definition, analysis, design, implementation, networks, security and life-cycle support
 
 •Schedule : Full-time In-Office
 •Travel : Occasionally

 Education: 
 Bachelor's Degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or other related scientific or technical discipline with a minimum of four years of related experience or a similar Master’s Degree and two years of related experience.
 Experience in supporting small to mid-sized organizations (100+ users).
 Experience in the analysis, design, implementation and support of large, complex, inter-networked systems.


 A TS/SCI clearance is required to begin employment. For this position, CACI has the ability to provide clearance sponsorship for qualified individuals.  
 
 
- 
 
 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$90,300 - 189,600 USD 
 
 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
